verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS meeting-notes product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents Fellow's hosted service: a REST API, webhooks, an MCP server, and admin retention and export controls. Nothing shows a self-hosted, on-prem, or deployable version of the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
